mean_selection: frozen source-only posterior group choices; no target-dependent selection or variance adjustment
paths: all 24 existing paid paths on eight task laws, kept fixed; three paths per task are correlated diagnostics
joint_likelihood: Gaussian sample mean marginalized over source-learned coefficients times exact log-sample-variance density; conditional coefficient posterior per risk particle
recommendation: finite-particle joint verifier power times independent objective quality; existing independent Gaussian moment recommendation retained as a diagnostic
evaluation: private oracle only after recommendations; no independent validation or new search
next_cost_budget_rule: using only source records at the default public context: each source task's minimum observed mean cost plus z0.95 times sample sd across its four paid policies; common budget levels are 1, the 25th and 50th percentiles across eight source minima
scientific_status: development attribution, not prospective decision evidence; new budget levels use source observations only
dispatch: local single thread only; no server jobs
